fields.Name: IT10 - Field Rules Bulk Update
fields.Description: End-to-end proof of the rules-based bulk-update stack (deterministic, no model calls): FieldRulesProcessor → EntityFieldRules → the pure field-rules engine, applied across a real record set in both modes against throwaway MJ: Action Categories it creates. FR1: DRY-RUN computes the per-record diff and writes NOTHING. FR2: APPLY writes the formula result and MJ's Record Changes versioning captures it. FR3: a rule whose condition is false leaves its field untouched (per-record gating — only the record whose Name ends in -2 flips to Disabled). The bundle creates + tears down its own category fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Dry-run previews with zero writes; apply writes the formula result; a false condition gates the field per-record.
